Circuit: 5V -> + rail -> photoresistor (col 6 to col 10) -> junction in column 10 -> A0 via blue wire; 10k resistor from column 10 to column 13 -> black wire -> - rail -> GND. This matches the schematic.
The image's upper breadboard block is labelled j-f, so it maps to the catalogue's bank 'b' (rows f-j). The top power rails are used: tp = red + rail, tn = black - rail.
Exact rail hole numbers (tp.1, tp.6, tn.4, tn.13) are estimated from the image; each rail is one strip, so only the rail matters electrically.
The black GND wire goes to the second GND pin of the Uno power header (GND.2).
Photoresistor and resistor are non-polar, so the leg assignment (1/2) is arbitrary.
